cards.card_text: “Light is withheld from the wicked, and their upraised arm is broken.” Then the LORD's questions head down, WAY down, deeper than the back of the junk drawer I spent years in.
cards.verse_text: Light is withheld from the wicked, and their upraised arm is broken. Have you journeyed to the vents of the sea or walked in the trenches of the deep?
